facts.text: The party must bring metal from the Dwarven mine back to Warwick the smith, in exchange for his loan of the mithril chain shirt. Meanwhile Warwick keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre to play every night against the Clurichen.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, his grandfather's armor. Warwick holds the party's plate armor, claimed to be Sir Brandon's, as collateral until then.
Wayman Tisdale wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt, on loan, over his leather armor. It greatly improves his protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells.
The Dwarven mine's entrance is sealed by a natural-looking cave-in, which blocks bringing metal to Warwick. It can be dug through, and a dead dwarf lies in the rubble.
